objective: Make OCR provider execution transport-neutral inside the HTTP crate while preserving every existing REST error code, status, message, provider policy, and success payload.

architecture.owner: crate-private multipart_and_ocr/provider_runtime with response_payload as the only HTTP failure adapter
production_surface: static provider selection for Tesseract, local JSON OCR, and network LLM vision
typed unavailable, timeout, invalid-output, and reauthentication failures
provider-specific process, IO, parsing, auth, and network adapters
deleted_boundaries: production wildcard imports from the multipart facade
local JSON temporary-file errors borrowing the Tesseract message mapper
unchanged_boundaries: REST paths, status codes, errorCode values, messages, and success payloads
cancel, rate-limit, image-size, auth persistence, and receipt-draft ordering
network URL allowlist, SSRF, redirect, payload-size, token, and response-size policy
database schema, user scope, configuration shape, and raw provider result shape
rejected_expansion: async trait, dynamic registry, service, UnitOfWork, cache, transaction owner, or second writer
parallel OcrRequest or OcrObservation DTOs beside OcrProviderTextResult
moving unrelated LLM, learning, or configuration transport contracts
weakening merge-blocking E2E or CI topology in this slice

red.result: failed because provider_runtime.rs did not exist
failed to compile because OcrProviderFailure and its response mapper did not exist

verification.cargo_test_workspace: passed against a fresh isolated PostgreSQL database with zero failed or ignored test cases

cargo_llvm_cov_workspace.result: passed against a fresh isolated PostgreSQL database with zero failed or ignored test cases; the final LCOV also includes the two added deterministic boundary tests

review.standards_axis: approved; URL validation, SSRF, redirect, secret, user-scope, and process isolation boundaries are preserved
review.spec_axis: approved; the accepted private typed boundary is complete without trait, registry, service, or parallel DTO expansion

verification.money_review: No amount field or yuan/cent conversion changed.
verification.delivery_evidence: The Gitea PR and exact-head Actions run remain the authoritative external delivery evidence and are added after this commit is pushed.

false_starts: An initial broad HTTP library run without BILL_ANALYSER_TEST_POSTGRES_URL produced only explicit PostgreSQL environment failures; it was excluded and rerun successfully against a fresh isolated database.
The first changed-line coverage calculation was 89.74 percent and was rejected; deterministic allowlist-restore and generic Tesseract IO tests raised the measured result to 90.91 percent.
residual_risks: Real Tesseract and local JSON child-process execution remains environment-dependent; this slice characterizes typed mappers and parsing without invoking installed or paid providers.
Other AiRouteResponse ownership in LLM, learning, and configuration paths remains outside C7n.
CI runtime topology is intentionally deferred because skipping the deterministic E2E gate would weaken the accepted merge-blocking contract.

environment_hygiene.test_database_strategy: HTTP, workspace, and coverage gates used exact-name isolated PostgreSQL databases that were dropped after each command.
environment_hygiene.provider_strategy: network tests used an in-process loopback TCP fixture; no real or paid OCR/LLM endpoint was called
environment_hygiene.secrets: The existing local PostgreSQL credential was held only in process-local environment variables and was not added to source or evidence.
